paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Solar energy-loss bound from SNO all-flavor neutrino flux. Primary result is axion-photon coupling g_aγ < 7e-10 GeV^-1 (Eq. 4), a flat limit applying to sub-keV axion masses (solar core ~1 keV). This is a stellar/solar bound, not a haloscope, so no DM density applies. The paper also derives boson-electron Yukawa couplings (pseudoscalar 2.8e-11, scalar 2.4e-13, vector 1.7e-13 at mχ=0, with mass dependence up to ~10 keV in Fig. 1) which would correspond to AxionElectron (PS case) but the headline result is the axion-photon limit.
